1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

20. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem is configured to have a variable length such that said stem can be adjusted for different extensions from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus. 

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw mechanism.
